set.body: Use SurfaceMeshDomain topology and order for exact locus identity; adapt SurfaceField, SurfaceRoi, and LabeledSurface; construct geodesic searchlights through shared relations while keeping fragmentation and parcel geometry in surface. Acceptance follows phase 6 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md, including topology mismatch, closed-ball and radius-zero laws, disconnected-fiber semantics, fragmentation-policy tests, JVM, and Scala.js gates.
set.title: Locus 6: migrate surface domains, labels, parcels, and searchlights
